body: # World Markets. S&P 500 and Nasdaq close lower as chip stock rebound fails. S&P 500 closes higher as chips stage a comeback, Iran stops strikes on Israel. European stocks volatile on Thursday as Iran Supreme Leader demands uranium to stay. Asia-Pacific markets trade higher as investors assess U.S.-Iran peace deal diplomacy. European stocks advance: UK inflation and elevated bond yields in focus. European markets finish higher as politics dominates the news agenda. European markets close higher, UK gilts volatile as pressure mounts on PM Starmer. European markets close lower as Iran reportedly makes peace proposal. European stocks close higher; Nokia and L'Oreal shares soar on earnings beats. European stocks end near flat as UK GDP jumps and Iran peace talks remain in focus. European markets close higher as traders hope peace talks can resume. Sign up for free newsletters and get more CNBC delivered to your inbox.
